The exact first Fer change V=exp(-B)U has R=exp(-B)S exp(B)-integral_0^1 exp(-theta B)S exp(theta B)dtheta. Odd commutators are skew; sym R=sum_{j>=1}2j ad_B^(2j)S/(2j+1)!, bounded by c(r)||[B,[B,S]]|| after centering B. A 2x2 diagonal/off-diagonal example attains the local coefficient; integrated and diffusion constants are not claimed sharp. In a differentiable eigenframe the double commutator has off-diagonal entries -(b_i-b_j)^3 Omega_ij; the invariant formula survives degeneracies.

Ten symmetric zero-integral pulses form D_epsilon with det=1, trace=2+16 sinh^6(epsilon)cosh^2(epsilon) and log rho=2 asinh(2 sinh^3(epsilon)cosh(epsilon))=4epsilon^3+O(epsilon^5), while ||B||<=sqrt(5)epsilon. Cubic-order growth rejects a universal quartic replacement. Smooth cycles with epsilon_j~j^-1/3 compressed into finite time make B tend to zero but U unbounded; j^-2/5 yields finite cubic action despite divergent absolute strain and first-commutator action. These sharpen matrix sufficient conditions; no fluid realization or singularity follows.

For smooth fields on a flat torus, L=partial_t+v dot grad-nu Delta, Lz=Sz and LB=S, B(0)=0, put y=exp(-B)z, D=||[B,[B,S]]||, G=sum_i||partial_i B||^2, a(r)=integral_0^1 exp(rtheta)dtheta and h(r)=2integral_0^1 theta exp(rtheta)dtheta. The proposed domination is L|y|^2<=2q|y|^2, q=c(r)D+nu(h(r)+a(r)^2)G. Exponential first/second derivative bounds and square completion supply it; the maximum principle bounds ||z(t)||_infinity by exp(sup_x lambda_max B+integral||q||_infinity)||z0||_infinity. Even scalar commuting S=nu a cos x has bounded B=a(1-exp(-nu t))cos x while a positive eigenvalue drives growth: diffusion requires a spatial cost.

For classical unforced incompressible 3D Euler/Navier-Stokes on the torus, u0 in H^s, s>5/2, vorticity obeys Lomega=S omega, S=sym grad u. B bounded and integral(||[B,[B,S]]||_infinity+nu||sum_i||partial_iB||^2||_infinity)<infinity imply bounded vorticity and continuation by established criteria. Euler has nu=0. A weaker VISCOUS alternative uses q_E=c(r)D+nu(h+2a^2)G and integral q_E f^2<=nu/4 integral|grad f|^2+alpha(t)integral f^2, alpha integrable, plus bounded B. It bounds enstrophy/H1 and gives viscous continuation; it is not an Euler H1 criterion.

The automatic averaged estimate ||B(t)||_(2,F)^2+nu integral||grad B||_(2,F)^2<=3/nu integral||u||_2^2<=3t||u0||_2^2/nu does not close bounded B, spatial suprema/critical forms or cubic action. Noncircular self-consistent nonlinear closure remains the decisive missing mathematical capability. Actual strain history and validated temporal/spatial error bounds are required; dense commutator evaluation costs ordinary O(n^3) arithmetic and a numerical field alone does not certify continuum quantities. Fer factorization and continuation machinery are classical. No independently major consequence, general fluid regularity, computational speedup, technology application or historical novelty is established.
